AI Data Centers Face Scrutiny Over Power Demands and Economic Impact

The rapid expansion of AI data centers in the US is leading to significant power demands, causing shortages and requiring utility companies to plan orders years in advance. Concerns are also being raised about the concentration of wealth and power by AI companies, with opposition to data center growth emerging across the political spectrum.
